<!--
Use this for a problem with an EXISTING tool's listing — a license that
changed, a Docker image pinned to ":latest" that should be a fixed version,
a dead link, a stale star count, an incorrect fossModel, etc.

To suggest a brand-new tool instead, use the "Add a tool" template.
-->

## Tool

<!-- The tool's name and slug, e.g. "Nextcloud" (/tool/nextcloud) -->

## What's wrong

<!-- Be specific. e.g.:
- "License field says MIT, but v5.0 relicensed to AGPL-3.0 — see <link to LICENSE file>"
- "dockerCompose still uses image:latest — current stable tag is X.Y.Z per <link to registry/release>"
- "githubUrl / websiteUrl returns 404"
- "fossModel is marked FOSS but the project has a paid Enterprise tier — should be OpenCore"
-->

## Source / proof

<!-- A link to the repo's LICENSE file, the registry's tags page, the release
     notes, or wherever this can be verified. We won't change a field without
     something to check it against — no correction gets merged on "trust me". -->
